name: Joolie Health Comprehensive Nursing Asset
description: Comprehensive nursing assessment from the supplied form, including insurance, start of care, medical history, allergies, medications, directives and caregiver details. Uses existing body maps and repeatable assessments. Risk totals are entered manually.

sections.title: Insurance and start of care
sections.description: Record health insurance name, policy number and actual start-of-care date as shown in the patient record. These are assessment snapshots and do not update billing or intake records.

sections.title: Diagnoses and medical history
sections.description: Record diagnosis dates separately from onset dates. Surgical procedure codes are entered as text; the diagnosis picker is used for diagnoses.

sections.title: Allergies
sections.description: Record the status explicitly. An unanswered field does not mean no known allergies. These entries are stored with this assessment.

sections.title: Standing medication regimen
sections.description: Document the medication regimen at the time of assessment. These entries do not create or change eMAR orders or synchronize automatically with the patient medication list.

sections.title: Advance directives and DNR
sections.description: Record directive and document status for this assessment. Documenting a status here does not create a directive or physician order.

fields.label: Secondary / other caregivers — names, relationships and roles

sections.title: Visit and assessment context
sections.description: Record findings for this assessment. Insurance, history, medications, allergies, directives and support details are included in the preceding sections. Patient identity is linked through the client record.

fields.label: Eye findings, side (right/left), and infection details
Nose / throat / mouth findings and locations
Headache and wound assessment details / body-map reference

sections.title: Pain assessment
sections.description: Use the existing body map for location; enter numeric pain scores from 0 to 10. The supplied paper form has three pain sites.

sections.title: Skin condition and wounds
sections.description: Match wound numbers to body-map notes. Up to five wounds, as on the supplied paper form.

sections.title: Cardiopulmonary assessment
sections.description: Complete according to organizational policy. Units must accompany height, weight and temperature.

fields.label: Weight change over weeks / months / years

sections.title: Nutritional risk screening
sections.description: Source-form scoring: add points for yes responses. 0–2: reassess / provide information as appropriate. 3–5: educate, refer, monitor and reevaluate per patient situation and organization policy. 6+: coordinate with physician, dietician, social service professional or nurse; reassess and educate on the plan of care. Total is entered manually.

fields.label: Illness or condition changes kind or amount of food eaten (2 points if yes)
Eats fewer than two meals per day (3 points if yes)
Eats few fruits, vegetables or milk products (2 points if yes)
Has three or more drinks of beer, liquor or wine almost every day (2 points if yes)
Tooth or mouth problems make eating hard (2 points if yes)
Does not always have enough money for needed food (4 points if yes)
Eats alone most of the time (1 points if yes)
Takes three or more different prescribed or over-the-counter drugs per day (1 points if yes)
Unintentional loss or gain of 10 lb in the last six months (2 points if yes)
Not always physically able to shop, cook and/or feed self (2 points if yes)
Ileostomy / colostomy site and peristomal skin
Other elimination site and surrounding skin
NG / enteral tube type and size
Spiritual / cultural impacts on current care

sections.title: Infusion access and site care
sections.description: Record this assessment and administered treatment. The standing medication snapshot is documented in Standing medication regimen; neither section changes eMAR orders.

fields.label: Epidural / intrathecal site and skin condition
Epidural / intrathecal infusion solution, volume and rate

sections.title: Fall risk assessment
sections.description: Source-form scoring: add points for each yes; institute fall precautions for a total of 15 or greater, according to organizational guidelines. Medication examples in source: antihistamines, antihypertensives, antiseizure drugs, benzodiazepines, cathartics, diuretics, hypoglycemics, narcotics, psychotropics and sedatives / hypnotics. Total is entered manually.

fields.label: History of falls in past three months (15 points if yes)
Sensory deficit (vision and/or hearing) (5 points if yes)
Increased anxiety / emotional lability (5 points if yes)
Unable to ambulate independently (ambulatory aid, chair board, etc.) (5 points if yes)
Gait / balance / coordination problems (5 points if yes)
Cardiovascular / respiratory disease affecting perfusion and/or oxygenation (5 points if yes)
Postural hypotension with dizziness (5 points if yes)
Medications affecting blood pressure or consciousness (5 points if yes)
Home safety issues (lighting, pathway, cords, tubing, floor coverings, stairs, etc.) (5 points if yes)
Lack of home modifications (bathroom, kitchen, stairs / entries, etc.) (5 points if yes)
Fall-prevention education specific to identified risks
Unsafe gas / electrical appliances or outlets
No telephone or unable to use phone
Smoke detectors on all home levels
Knows how to use backup oxygen

sections.title: Activities of daily living
sections.description: Paper columns I / A / D are represented as one assistance-level choice per activity, with a separate teach / train field.

options: When to contact physician and/or agency
